reviews.title: AS3 E4X/Vector/global re-audit, binary/event interfaces, InteractiveObject, JPEG and text
reviews.summary: Re-audits all 98 AS3 needs_review entries with compiled behavioral probes and implements IDataInput, IDataOutput, CompressionAlgorithm, ObjectEncoding, IEventDispatcher, aggregated EventDispatcher, InteractiveObject, SimpleButton, MouseEvent/Event constants, Graphics.beginBitmapFill, JPEGEncoderOptions, DisplacementMapFilter and Area 6 text classes.

entries.note: Reads and writes NetStream SoundTransform volume in [0, 1]; nonzero stereo pan is rejected on HTML5 media elements.
Defaults to false and validates Boolean writes; shareable=true is rejected because Flash Worker shared memory is outside the HTML5 profile.

Interactive hierarchy checks, abstract construction guard, mouse/tab/focus/menu/accessibility properties and core pointer/keyboard/focus/text events work; softKeyboard and nativeDrag/touch/clipboard members remain unimplemented.
Supports BitmapData.applyFilter across all four DisplacementMapFilterMode modes; DisplayObject.filters map snapshots are not implemented yet.
Custom namespace qualifiers (AS3, flash_proxy, object_proxy) are rejected with an explicit compiler diagnostic.
